name: Katie Dooley
story: Katie Dooley of the New Zealand Transport Agency co-presented a 2017 conference session on how the agency and the North Canterbury Transport Infrastructure Recovery alliance used GIS for collaboration after the Kaikōura earthquake. The presentation records geospatial work inside a large transport-recovery programme.
